description: NaNbO₂F₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one O and five F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.57 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.82 Å. Nb is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NbO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-32°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.20 Å. There is one shorter (2.05 Å) and one longer (2.08 Å) Nb-F bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Nb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Nb atom.
